action: Starts from the finished model in Object Mode (Body and Hair1 under the Model collection, reference planes behind) before switching to UV work.
why: Note the starting polycount and pick the Body object to unwrap
reader_equivalent: Read len(obj.data.polygons) for Body and Hair1; set Body as the active object

action: In Edit Mode, wireframe view of the boots, selects edge loops around the boot cuffs and ankles (orange) to use as seams.
why: Cut the boot into separate tube and sole pieces
reader_equivalent: bmesh: select the cuff/ankle edge loops, then bpy.ops.mesh.mark_seam(clear=False)

action: In the UV Editing workspace selects one boot part at a time (the sole ring, then the lower boot band) and unwraps it; each part appears alone as one island in the UV editor.
view: UV Editor (left) + 3D Viewport Edit Mode face select (right)
why: Unwrap small parts separately and check each island
reader_equivalent: Select the part's faces, bpy.ops.uv.unwrap(method='ANGLE_BASED', margin=0.001)

action: Shows the boots from the front with red seam lines running down the boot fronts.
why: Seam on the boot front so the tube opens flat
reader_equivalent: Mark the vertical front edge column of each boot as seam with bpy.ops.mesh.mark_seam()

action: Uses Select Linked on the whole body; the UV editor shows a long stretched overlapping layout, then selects only the skirt faces (Select Linked) to work on them.
why: Isolate one connected piece (skirt) to unwrap it alone
reader_equivalent: Select one face of the skirt, bpy.ops.mesh.select_linked(delimit={'SEAM'})

action: Zooms on the shoulder/sleeve-top blocks with nothing selected, preparing the next part.
why: Inspect the next part to cut
reader_equivalent: None needed; pick the next part by name or by face index

action: Reveals hidden parts and selects all of Body; the UV editor shows the whole mesh's current (still unfinished, overlapping) UVs.
why: Check what is still not unwrapped

action: Marks seams along the inner arm/sleeve and, in X-ray wireframe, along the back and the back of the legs (red lines).
why: Hide seams on the less visible inner and back sides
reader_equivalent: Select inner-arm, back-centre and back-of-leg edge paths, bpy.ops.mesh.mark_seam()

action: With a seam around the top of each thigh, unwraps the hand/finger pieces; a thin hand island shows at the left of the UV square.
why: Separate legs from the hips and unwrap the hands
reader_equivalent: Mark thigh-top loop as seam, select the hand faces, bpy.ops.uv.unwrap()

action: Selects the fingers and back of the hand, opens the UV Mapping menu and picks Unwrap.

settings.menu_items_seen: Unwrap, Smart UV Project, Lightmap Pack, Follow Active Quads, Cube Projection, Cylinder Projection, Sphere Projection, Project from View, Project from View (Bounds), Mark Seam, Clear Seam, Reset

why: Unwrap the hand as its own island

action: Marks seams around each fingertip and along a loop across the knuckles/back of the hand (red).
why: Let the fingers open flat and split the hand from the wrist
reader_equivalent: Select fingertip loops and the knuckle loop, bpy.ops.mesh.mark_seam()

action: Marks seams at the crotch where the legs meet the shorts.
why: Split legs from the hips

action: Selects the belt with Select Linked and unwraps it into one long strip island; unwraps a single belt pouch piece (Unwrap redo).
why: Each accessory piece is its own island

action: Opens the UV Mapping menu again on a belt pouch and picks Unwrap.
why: Unwrap the pouch alone

action: In X-ray wireframe selects small hidden faces (under the belt/collar) and removes them; the body face count drops from about 1,699 to 1,667.
why: Drop faces nobody sees so they take no texture space

action: Selects edges of a collar/band loop, then hides parts to see the torso underneath.
why: Clear the view to place seams on the torso

action: Selects the body skin (torso, legs, head) and unwraps it; the UV editor shows clean separate islands for torso, legs, sleeves and face.
why: Unwrap the main skin pieces after all seams are set

action: Checks in Object Mode with the chest and belt in view; scene count is lower than at the start.
why: Check the shape after deleting hidden faces
reader_equivalent: Compare polygon counts before and after

action: Uses Select More on the chest area and unwraps a small piece (small island in the middle of the UV square).
why: Unwrap remaining chest pieces

action: With all Body faces selected, the islands sit in a cluster outside the UV square; the UV map is named UVMap.
why: Gather all islands before laying them out

action: Creates a new image in the UV editor at 1024 x 1024.
view: UV Editor, Create a New Image dialog
why: Make the texture canvas for hand painting

action: Islands are moved and placed by hand inside the square (Move redo panel), larger islands for body and face, many small pieces around them; the image shown is female_char1.
why: Fill the 0-1 square with all pieces without overlap
reader_equivalent: bpy.ops.uv.pack_islands(rotate=True, margin=0.01) as the closest scripted step (artist arranged by hand)

action: Switches to the Shading workspace on Hair2, file browser open in Documents, Principled BSDF to Material Output for the Hair material.
why: Set up material/texture slots after the unwrap
